Pay undisputed invoices early for a 2% discount with a 30 day dispute plan (saves about USD 8.2K, recommended), agree Arden's tranche plan (no cost, no discount), hold position until disputes settle (no cost but high risk of a shipment hold on the sole-source sleeve kits), offer supply chain finance (no cost, 21 days to onboard), or move the cascade overhauls to Prairie Composites (USD 21K premium and 70 day lead).

The recommended early payment is the cheapest because it is a saving: 2% on the cleared balance is worth about USD 8.2K, against nothing for the tranche plan or supply chain finance. The real cost of getting this wrong is not the discount but a hold on the sleeve kits: beyond 8 Nov every day costs USD 12K of Tanjong Pacific LDs.

In 2025 the same strategic nacelle repair vendor came under cash pressure and threatened to hold shipments over disputed invoices (PRE-12). We paid the undisputed items early for a 2% discount and settled the disputes within 30 days, a net saving of USD 8.2K, and shipments continued. The lesson was to separate undisputed from disputed items because paying the clean ones fast buys goodwill at a profit.

The induction does not move today. WO-2609 inducts into Nacelle cell N-04 on 29 Oct and the sleeve kits on 4500018464-00010 now arrive 5 Nov, a 7 day slip inside 10 days of float, so the 8 Dec redelivery holds. If Arden holds the kits more than 3 more days, the Tanjong Pacific redelivery starts to move at USD 12K per day.
